executionModel.commitOwner: The workflow commits with the AGENTS.md 1-6 section message and no tool attribution or co-authorship. Workers never commit, stash, checkout, reset, branch, push, merge or create worktrees. BV-30 runs only read-only git status/diff.
executionModel.editProtocol: Fresh-read each file before editing and record shasum -a 256 before and after in the plan's Progress Log. On drift, stop, record, re-read and re-apply only this plan's change. Never edit outside writePaths. Each worker edits only its own plan's Progress Log.
executionModel.measurementLock: /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/vactr-worktrees/.measure-lock guards full nextest, any vitest that loads wasm, full vitest, test:style and e2e:examples (sibling run wf-vim-mode is active). mkdir before, rmdir right after; if mkdir fails, foreground sleep 30 and retry (bounded); never remove a lock this command did not create; never kill processes this run did not start.
executionModel.ports: editor/test/e2e/serve.mjs serves dist on an OS-assigned port (listen(0)); 5173 and 5174 are never used. Foreground commands only.
executionModel.wasmRebuild: BV-10 and BV-30 rebuild the debug cdylib target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/vactr.wasm after Rust changes; BV-30 runs mise run build-wasm-release before npm run build and e2e:examples.

verificationNotes: Each plan's verification array is its gating list only (exit 0 required). Commands run from the repository root and end with the command's own exit status. The BV-10 mutation run (revert the kit_keys union, template_sounds must fail, restore, must pass) is mutationEvidence only and stays in the plan text. Lock-wrapped commands retry mkdir up to 120 times at 30 s intervals and release only the lock they created.

reviewContext.userProblem: editor/src/examples/manifest.ts EXCLUDED hides nine repository examples (acid-techno, offbeat-bass-techno, rumble-techno, wobble-techno, bass-presets, experimental-oscillators, hurdy-gurdy, kalimba, tonewheel-organ) because evaluation reports unknown-keyword '`:<name>` is not a sound in the default sound kit' for prelude template voices. The issue says 8 examples but its own list and manifest.ts:67-75 name nine; all nine are in scope.
reviewContext.rootCause: The checker accepts a sound keyword only from kit_keys (manifest.sound_kit_keys() = 13 SPEC_SOUNDS + 7 SPEC_SYNTHS, src/types/check.rs:185), document inst_names, or session Inst globals. load_templates realizes templates.vact in a scratch namespace (src/ns/insts.rs:930-951), so none of the three contains the templates. There is no tier divergence: native and wasm-host sessions assemble the checker identically; native tests pass only because they ignore check diagnostics (src/ns/evaluator.rs:357-367, src/host/tests/e2e.rs:123-135), while editor/test/wasm/examples.test.ts rejects error diagnostics.
requiredOutcomes: Root cause documented in design-browser-tier-voices.md; fix applied at the shared checker manifest assembly with one source of truth (the InstRegistry's realized template set), no hand-maintained name list.
Every template that load_templates realizes in a tier is accepted as an `s :name` sound by both the eval check and Session::check (static/editor path) in that tier.

All nine examples evaluate without errors in the wasm browser tier and are registered in the picker ('Examples' category, title-cased titles, header-derived descriptions <= 140 chars); EXCLUDED keeps only the six sample, native-only and song-mode rows.

Rust regression test src/session/tests/template_sounds.rs proves every registry template is accepted in native and host-wasm configurations, that :not-a-template-voice is still rejected, and that the nine examples statically check without errors.
cargo fmt --check, strict clippy, full nextest, host-wasm build, build-wasm-release, npm run check, full vitest, npm run test:style, npm run build and npm run e2e:examples pass.
nonGoals: No change to SPEC_SOUNDS, SPEC_SYNTHS, sound_kit_keys(), template_params(), default_sound_kit()/digital_kit() or either TEMPLATE_NAMES array; default-sound-kit keeps exactly 20 keys.
No template names in HostManifest.synths or sounds; the wire ManifestBody and completion stay byte-identical.
No change to analyze's signature/behavior, the standalone LSP (src/lsp/analysis.rs), src/ns/load.rs nested load checks, src/types/song_rules.rs or the diagnostic text.
Song-mode exclusions stay unchanged: they are the runtime fault 'finite song playback is unavailable until song transport is installed' (src/sched/runtime.rs:372-377), a separate intended limitation.
No DSP, codec, UGen, control-row or golden-digest change; VACTR_BLESS_GOLDEN is never set.
No UI/CSS or editor/src/code change; no CodeMirror EditorView.
constraints: Work only in this worktree on wf/browser-voices; never touch other worktrees or main; never kill processes the run did not start (wf-vim-mode is active).

AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, no tool attribution in commits; every touched source file under 1000 lines (src/ns/insts.rs is at 970; split template loading into src/ns/insts/templates.rs if it would reach 1000).
Project UI style (solid, flat, square, spaced); npm run test:style must pass.
Registries are append-only; golden digests append-only; follow design-bass-voices.md 'Registration and digest stability'.
Heavy suites serialized with the .measure-lock directory; e2e serve on port 0, never 5173/5174; foreground commands only.
Example fixes (BV-30 only): smallest edit, no new samples/MIDI/host input, every gain equal to or lower than current, never restore an exclusion; never change system volume.
Out-of-writePaths mechanical test/fixture updates caused by the change are fixed within the plan and listed.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Source of truth is the set of templates.vact inst forms that load_templates realized into the session InstRegistry: it is already the file new voices are appended to and it is already tier-aware (a template beyond InstRegistry::caps goes to template_errors), so no new list exists.

InstRegistry gets template_sounds: Rc<BTreeSet<Rc<str>>> filled only on load_one success (union, because one registry may serve several Evaluators); accessor template_sounds_rc mirrors declared_names_rc.

HostManifest gets a separate templates: KeySet (empty in spec_default) plus with_templates, instead of widening synths, to keep the prelude dict, template_params, wire ManifestBody.synths and completion byte-identical.

Checker kit_keys = sound_kit_keys() union templates at src/types/check.rs:185, so sound_arg and song_rules change together with no edit at those sites; sound_kit_is_prelude still disables the check when sound-kit is rebound.
Evaluator::dynamic_manifest adds with_templates; early return only when both declared names and template sounds are empty; cache keys on both Rcs via Rc::ptr_eq; 4-entry eviction kept.
Session::check uses analyze_in(text, fid, view, &ev.dynamic_manifest(&spec_default())) so the editor's static check matches eval; analyze stays a one-line delegate for the LSP and packages tests.
intentionalTradeoffs: Session::check now also sees the registry's declared template parameters (for example kalimba-beat), matching eval; a session test pinning a static-only diagnostic would need a listed mechanical update.
Standalone LSP and nested load ./file.vact keep spec-default behavior (no registry there); accepted design boundary.
A set union per dynamic-manifest cache miss; the cache hits after the first form.
supportedEdgeCases: A template that fails realization in a tier (caps) is not accepted there and shows as a template_errors regression-test failure.
Registries with templates never loaded and Evaluators without a registry accept exactly what they accepted before.
One InstRegistry shared by several Evaluators (union semantics).
sound-kit rebound by the document (check disabled as before).
Unknown keywords (:not-a-template-voice, :not-a-sound) still produce exactly one unknown-keyword.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Standalone LSP without a session and nested load ./file.vact checks.
Sample-dependent and native-only examples (sample-timestamps.vact, tracks/breakcore/glass-teeth.vact, quad-stems.vact).
residualRisks: BV-10 and BV-20 cite decision labels BTV-D2..D9 that design-browser-tier-voices.md does not define; each plan also names the design sections it means (low, non-blocking).
Rig::eval (src/session/tests/support.rs:82) returns (EvalResultBody, Vec<ServerMsg>), so the BV-10 test must destructure before reading diagnostics (low; compiler-caught).
The static Session::check over the nine examples may surface an unrelated pre-existing error; BV-10 stops for serial reconciliation instead of weakening the test, and BV-30 owns example fixes.
Measurement-lock contention with the sibling wf-vim-mode run.
